name: PROBLEM 6
description: PROBLEM 6 (formerly PROPHETIC 6): a 7-voice analogue-style poly in the spirit of the classic American analogue polys. Two oscillators with sub and noise, poly mod, a resonant high-pass into a creamy 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs (LFO 1 to audio rate and noise), distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp. The same engine as the PROBLEM 6 VST3 and the FM-1 firmware.
author: swtdr34mz
